item.title: Self-Hosted ICMP Network Probing: fping vs hping3 vs nping for Network Diagnostics
item.description: ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) probing is the foundation of network diagnostics, from basic reachability testing to advanced packet crafting and security auditing. While the standard ping command handles simple cases, production environments demand tools that can scan hundreds of hosts in parallel, craft custom packet headers, or generate detailed latency statistics.
